name: Kettlebell Figure-8 March
description: Hold a light kettlebell and march in place, lifting one knee at a time. As each knee lifts, pass the bell hand-to-hand around the outside of the lifted thigh — weaving a continuous figure-8 around the legs in rhythm with the march. The bell never stops moving and you're balanced on one foot at a time, so the standing-leg hip and the core fight the rotational pull while the marching keeps the heart rate up. Chest up, eyes forward, ribs down, march rhythmic. Light bell only — this is coordination, balance, and conditioning, not load.
